title: Actionist typed edit operation
description: Research-only contract proposal. UNEXECUTED, NOT_ADMITTED. An operation that cannot be expressed in this schema is unrepresentable by construction — that is the enforcement mechanism, not a runtime check.

verb.description: Closed set. An eighth verb is a schema change requiring a recorded contract transition, never a runtime extension.

substrate.description: Determines the authority answer, never the vocabulary. Maps to P08 mount profiles: embedded_module=absorbed_native, intact_service=preserved_framed.

anchor_class.description: `coordinate` is deliberately absent from this enum. Coordinate-bound edits are unupgradeable in principle (I-P13-2) and therefore have no encoding.

upgrade_debt.description: True for donor_export anchors: each one is a patch hunk carrying a permanent merge obligation.

intent.description: WHY, version-independent. Survives upgrade. Never discarded.

resolution.description: HOW the intent was satisfied against one capability version. The ONLY disposable part — discarded and re-resolved on upgrade.

prior_value.description: Inverse, recorded so `remove` and every other verb is undoable.

orphaned_bindings.description: Bindings orphaned by this operation. Reported, never silently dropped.

within_declared_scope.description: C2: composition scope is the INTERSECTION of member scopes, never the union. A data-binding operation outside declared scope is denied, not escalated.

grants_new_authority.description: C1: an edit may never grant data, tenant or side-effect authority. Structurally pinned to false.

permission.description: Travels in the persisted composition record, not in editor configuration (Puck readOnly-in-BaseData shape). Editor-only permission is bypassed by upgrades, migrations, agents and direct API writes.

violated_constraint.description: REQUIRED when status=denied. The named constraint, never a generic refusal.

nearest_supported_alternative.description: REQUIRED when status=denied. A denial without an alternative is indistinguishable from a broken product (U-5).

overriding_rule.description: REQUIRED when status=deferred. The governing rule, by name.

contract_transition.description: REQUIRED when status=escalated. The proposed transition and its price.

receipt.description: C5: approval binds to an artifact hash; silence is never approval.

state.description: DEGRADED and ORPHANED are kept and named, never silently dropped. Either blocks auto-publish.
